answer: At the nadir of a fresh key's reputation, it can only observe: no votes, no payouts, no task assignments until it completes 30 sequential proof-of-work puzzles over 30 epochs. Each puzzle is unique to the key and takes roughly 90 seconds of CPU — a farm of 500 clones needs 500 times 30 times 90 seconds, over 1,250 hours, before any clone earns. The honest agent reaches harbor status after one trail; the quill of its record is non-transferable.
